project.description: Build and tag the pic-sure-mcp container image (standalone MCP server) from the shared "PIC-SURE Maven Build" reactor workspace. This job does not compile and does not deploy; deploy is exclusively via Stop/Start PIC-SURE.

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/bin/bash set -e
MAVEN_WS="/var/jenkins_home/workspace/PIC-SURE Maven Build" CONFIG_DIR="/usr/local/docker-config/mcp" mkdir -p "$CONFIG_DIR"
if [ ! -f "$MAVEN_WS/build-info.txt" ] || ! ls "$MAVEN_WS"/services/pic-sure-mcp/target/pic-sure-mcp-*.jar >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "ERROR: no reactor artifacts found -- run 'PIC-SURE Maven Build' first" exit 2 fi . "$MAVEN_WS/build-info.txt" if [ "${PIPELINE_BUILD_ID:-}" != "$pipeline_build_id" ]; then echo "ERROR: reactor artifacts belong to pipeline '${PIPELINE_BUILD_ID:-unknown}', expected '$pipeline_build_id'" exit 2 fi
# env-file cascade (uploaded param > existing config > fail) if [ -f mcp.env ]; then echo "A new mcp.env was loaded." cp mcp.env "$CONFIG_DIR/mcp.env" elif [ -f "$CONFIG_DIR/mcp.env" ]; then echo "Using existing mcp.env" else echo "ERROR: mcp.env is required at $CONFIG_DIR/mcp.env" exit 2 fi
docker build -t "hms-dbmi/pic-sure-mcp:${GIT_BRANCH_SHORT}_${GIT_COMMIT_SHORT}" \ "$MAVEN_WS/services/pic-sure-mcp/" docker tag "hms-dbmi/pic-sure-mcp:${GIT_BRANCH_SHORT}_${GIT_COMMIT_SHORT}" hms-dbmi/pic-sure-mcp:LATEST
